content: op-sqlite + drizzle-orm Expo setup: install @op-engineering/op-sqlite + drizzle-orm + drizzle-kit. Requires babel-plugin-inline-import for .sql migration files. drizzle.config needs dialect:'sqlite' and driver:'expo'. Metro config needs 'sql' in sourceExts. Database opened via open({name:'myDB'}) from op-sqlite, passed to drizzle(). Migrations run at startup via useMigrations(db, migrations) hook. op-sqlite is JSI-based (synchronous, no serialization overhead) — requires native build (no Expo Go). For most use cases expo-sqlite is simpler; op-sqlite wins when processing tens of thousands of records or doing complex joins.
